_comment: Framework-neutral MCP registry template. Project-specific servers live in profiles/[name]/mcp/registry.json (e.g. profiles/example-project/mcp/registry.json). Local-process commands MUST use 'pnpm dlx' per agents.md §8 — 'npx -y' is prohibited.

example-remote-mcp.description: Template entry for a remote MCP server. Duplicate, rename, and set status to 'enabled'.

example-local-mcp.description: Template entry for a local-process MCP server.
